title: Towards equilibrium molecular conformation generation with GFlowNets

metadata.authors: Volokhova A, Koziarski M, Hernández-García A, Liu CH, Miret S, Lemos P, Thiede L, Yan Z, Aspuru-Guzik A, Bengio Y

source_summary: This paper proposes using GFlowNets to sample diverse, low-energy molecular conformations from the Boltzmann distribution, enabling accurate reproduction of molecular potential energy surfaces and compatibility with various energy estimation methods.
abstract: Sampling diverse, thermodynamically feasible molecular conformations plays a crucial role in predicting properties of a molecule. In this paper we propose to use GFlowNets for sampling conformations of small molecules from the Boltzmann distribution, as determined by the molecule's energy. The proposed approach can be used in combination with energy estimation methods of different fidelity and discovers a diverse set of low-energy conformations for drug-like molecules. We demonstrate that GFlowNets can reproduce molecular potential energy surfaces by sampling proportionally to the Boltzmann distribution.
